definition: Shane Legg (born 1973 or 1974) is a machine learning researcher and entrepreneur.
details: With Demis Hassabis and Mustafa Suleyman, he cofounded DeepMind Technologies (later bought by Google and now called Google DeepMind), and works there as the chief AGI scientist. He is also known for his academic work on artificial general intelligence, including his thesis supervised by Marcus Hutter.

explainer.lead: Shane Legg is a machine learning researcher. His work spans machine learning.
